The summary only counts values the agreement fixes, and the category is not one of them. 2. C5: a whole-task check that every account read stayed on the approved list. Scope of a call works only on lines I name, at 10 per line, and the 50 allowance pays for at most 5 of the 100 reads. 3. C10: an outbox check that can go in a plan and compares the rows appended under the release with the confirmed sending calls. A confirmed call does not say whether it sent or only previewed. Trace of a call works only on named lines, at 10 each, and can cover at most 5 of 100. 4. The summary and same set never read the live tables after the promotion. What ties the live tables to the staged set is only the promotion's line in the record, so a cheap check of the live tables against the staged set would have helped.
